description: Tailor a supplied CV/resume to a specific job posting. Returns the actual tailored CV, before/after assessments, role-fit notes, interview preparation and a cover letter when available (otherwise null). Rules and automated checks are designed to prevent added facts; AI can make mistakes, so review every change. Text input/output only; does not access saved accounts, export PDFs or submit applications. Limited to 2 calls per day per network.

cvText.description: The full CV/resume as plain text, at most 20000 characters.

jobDescription.description: The job posting text, at most 20000 characters (CV and job together at most 20000 UTF-8 bytes).

name: tailor_cv
title: Tailor CV to a job
